description: Union of lexicon/uz.json, lexicon/ru.json, lexicon/en.json and lexicon/mixed.json. Every entry carries a `langs` array recording which source lexicons it came from. Surfaces are deduplicated across languages; when two sources disagreed on a field the conflict was resolved in the source files first, so no entry here is ambiguous.

conventions.purpose: Decision rules shared by all four lexicons and by every line of the corpus. Where a rule is stated here, no file may contradict it.
conventions.magnitude_ellipsis: A bare integer < 1000 with NO magnitude word and NO currency word in an expense/income frame means that many THOUSAND so'm ('taksiga 45' / 'такси 25' / 'coffee 15' -> 45000 / 25000 / 15000). THIS APPLIES IN EVERY LANGUAGE - the app is UZS-first and the rule must not depend on a language tag guessed from two tokens. Counter-rules: (a) if an explicit currency word is present the number is literal ('5 dollar' = 5); (b) digits >= 1000 are already literal; (c) a number immediately followed by -ta / kg / kilo / dona / litr / marta / штук / foiz / % is a QUANTITY, not an amount.
conventions.currency: currency is filled ONLY from an explicit currency token in the text. A bare number yields currency=null and the app applies the user's default later. Never infer UZS from a magnitude word ('ming', 'тыщ', 'k') and never from plausibility.
conventions.reject_convention: Queries, balance/budget statements, negations, future intentions, cancelled or returned purchases, price commentary, third-party payments and app commands are NOT transactions. They are labelled confidence = 0.0 with EVERY slot blanked: amount, currency, merchant, note and date all null and category 'other'. A single `confidence == 0.0` gate is therefore sufficient to refuse, in all four languages. `kind` has no null case in the schema, so it carries the direction the utterance implies.
conventions.multi_transaction: When one utterance contains several transactions, expected = the FIRST transaction only. Amounts are NEVER summed (a bill plus a tip is two records, not one total) and the line is scored 0.4. The remaining records cannot be expressed in a one-record schema and must be surfaced by the app.
conventions.transfer_class: ATM withdrawals, wallet top-ups, moving money to savings, lending, borrowing, repaying a loan, P2P card transfers and currency exchange move money without consuming it. The schema has no `transfer` kind, so they are recorded as expense/other (out) or income/other_income (in) at a FIXED confidence of 0.4 for the whole class.
conventions.date_enum: The ONLY legal date values are: today, yesterday, day_before_yesterday, last_<weekday>, this_<weekday>, <N>_days_ago, and null. There are no sentinels (no AMBIGUOUS/FUTURE/RECURRING/UNSUPPORTED) and no bare weekday names. Resolution rules: a time of day (ertalab / kechqurun / tushda / hozir / утром / вечером / this morning / tonight) -> today; a BARE weekday with no 'o'tgan'/'shu'/'прошлый'/'этот'/'last'/'this' modifier -> null, because it is genuinely ambiguous between past and future; an explicit day COUNT ('7 kun oldin', 'неделю назад', 'a week ago') -> <N>_days_ago; a PERIOD ('o'tgan hafta', 'на прошлой неделе', 'last week', 'o'tgan oy', 'this month', 'на выходных') -> null, because resolving it to a day would be an invention; an absolute calendar date ('8 mart', '1-sentabr', 'the 12th') -> null, with the phrase preserved in `note`; a recurrence ('har oy', 'oyiga', 'kuniga') -> null.
conventions.confidence_scale: Six points only, each with a written meaning. 0.95 = unambiguous, every slot recoverable. 0.8 = one small inference (fuzzy merchant match, cross-script token, spoken numeral, hedged amount). 0.6 = exactly one genuinely underdetermined slot (magnitude ellipsis, contested category, approximation). 0.4 = two or more underdetermined slots, a missing amount, a multi-transaction line, or the transfer class. 0.2 = intent is present but nothing is loggable - the app must prompt. 0.0 = not a transaction; refuse. `difficulty` is derived from this: 0.95 easy, 0.8 medium, <= 0.6 hard.
conventions.note_field: `note` is a SHORT EXTRACTIVE span of the user's own words - the item or service, in the language and script of the utterance - or null. It is never annotator commentary, never a translation, never a meta-description of the parse, and never a date phrase (except an absolute calendar date, which has nowhere else to go). All explanation belongs in the corpus row's `notes` field, which is not a model output.
conventions.merchant_canonicalisation: One brand yields exactly ONE gold string in every file: Korzinka, Korzinka Go, Makro, Havas, Chorsu Bozor, Oloy Bozori, Uzum ('uzum market' is a VARIANT surface of it, never a canonical), Evos, Oqtepa Lavash, Chopar Pizza, Max Way, Les Ailes, KFC, McDonald's, Express24, Yandex Eats, Yandex Taxi (bare 'yandex' in a spending context resolves here), Yandex Go, Yandex Plus, Yandex Lavka, Bolt, Uber, MyTaxi, Beeline, Ucell, Uzmobile, Mobiuz, Humans, Texnomart, Mediapark, Idea, Artel, Netflix, Spotify, iCloud, ChatGPT, Zara, Starbucks, Black Bear Coffee, OLX, Wildberries, Upwork, Kapitalbank, TBC Bank, Alif, Anor, Zoomrad, UzGasOil, Hududgaz. A personal name is NEVER a merchant.

category_rules.cafe_vs_dining: The VENUE word wins over the amount and over what was eaten. cafe / kafe / кафе / kofeynya / choy / kofe and the drink nouns -> cafe_coffee. restoran / choyxona / osh / lavash / somsa / burger / pizza / obed / tushlik and the meal nouns -> dining.
category_rules.groceries_vs_dining: Raw ingredients and supermarket/bozor merchants -> groceries, including supermarket DELIVERY. Prepared food, food delivery and eat-in venues -> dining.
category_rules.gaz: The VERB decides, never the noun: quydim / заправил / залил / 'filled the tank' -> fuel; to'ladim / заплатил / 'gaz puli' / 'за газ' / 'gas bill' -> utilities.
category_rules.car_spend: Consumed into the tank -> fuel. Service, parts, wash (moyka), parking, tyres, engine oil -> transport. State-imposed or contractual charges (shtraf / jarima / ГАИ / insurance / notary / customs) -> fees, even when a car triggered them.
category_rules.communication_vs_utilities: Billed by a TELECOM (mobile balance, HOME INTERNET, tariff, SIM) -> communication. Billed by the building or the municipality (svet, gaz bill, suv, issiq suv, chiqindi, kommunalka, domofon, lift, TSJ, mahalla puli) -> utilities. Home internet is communication in EVERY file.
category_rules.household_vs_other: Durable goods for the DWELLING (fridge, TV, kettle, furniture, carpet, lamps, remont, tools) -> household. PORTABLE PERSONAL DEVICES and their repairs (phone, laptop, macbook, headphones/naushnik, tablet, chargers, cases) -> other, in every language. The corpus has 8+ lines pleading for a dedicated `electronics` category; until the schema gains one, `other` is the agreed home.
category_rules.memberships: Physical-activity facilities (gym, sportzal, bassein, fitnes) -> health regardless of the word abonement/membership. Media and software recurring charges -> subscriptions. Venues attended for fun (kino, akvapark, bouling, konsert, teatr) -> entertainment.
category_rules.beneficiary: A NON-HUMAN beneficiary (mushuk / it / kuchuk / коту / собаке / cat / dog) -> pets, always. For a human beneficiary: if the object is a gift-type object (sovg'a / podarok / gul / atir / buket / present / flowers / toy) -> gifts; else if the object has its own category (dori -> health, kitob -> education, kiyim -> clothing) -> that category; else (bare cash) -> family.
category_rules.ceremonies: to'y / ma'raka / nikoh / gap / gashtak / xudoyi / beshik to'y / sunnat to'y / yubiley and any named gift object -> gifts. Unconditional cash to a relative -> family. sadaqa / ehson / zakot / masjid / xayriya / fond / yetimxona -> charity.
category_rules.child_spend: A named institution (maktab, bog'cha, universitet, kurs, kontrakt) wins over the physical item: a school uniform is education, a child's contract is education. Ordinary clothes with no institution named stay clothing.
category_rules.investment_vs_other_income: Proceeds from a financial instrument or income-producing asset (deposit interest, dividends, crypto, a flat rented out) -> investment. Proceeds from selling a personal possession -> other_income.
category_rules.water: The item or preposition decides, NEVER the amount size: 'бутылка воды' / 'suv oldim' -> groceries; 'за воду' / 'suv puli' -> utilities. Category-from-magnitude is not a rule a deterministic parser may implement.

magnitude_ellipsis.rule: In casual money talk Uzbeks DROP 'ming' constantly. A bare 2-3 digit number in an expense frame ('taksiga 45', 'korzinka 120', 'obed 35') means that many THOUSAND so'm, i.e. multiply by 1000.
magnitude_ellipsis.heuristic: If number < 1000 AND no magnitude word AND no currency word AND the context is a UZS-typical everyday category (transport, groceries, dining, cafe_coffee, fuel) -> multiply by 1000, confidence <= 0.65.
magnitude_ellipsis.counter_rule: If a currency word IS present, take the number literally: '5 dollar' = 5, '200 ko'k' = 200, '5000 so'm' = 5000. Never scale a number that carries an explicit currency.
magnitude_ellipsis.counter_rule_2: Numbers >= 1000 written as digits are already literal: '45000', '18500', '6000'. Do not scale.
magnitude_ellipsis.counter_rule_3: A number immediately followed by -ta, kg, kilo, dona, litr, marta, foiz/% is a QUANTITY, not an amount.

orthography_normalisation.detail: o' / o` / o’ / oʻ / o -> single canonical form. Same for g'. 'so'm', 'so`m', 'som', 'sum' must all hash to UZS.
Normalise both scripts to one internal key: ў->o', қ->q, ғ->g', ҳ->h, ш->sh, ч->ch, я->ya, ю->yu, ё->yo, ж->j, ц->ts, х->x, э->e.
Single utterances routinely mix scripts ('Korzinkadan 90 минг') because the keyboard was switched mid-sentence. Tokenise per-token, not per-utterance.

'45 000', '45.000', '45,000', '45000' all mean 45000. A space or dot INSIDE a digit run is a thousands separator, not a decimal point — but '1.5 mln' IS a decimal. Disambiguate by whether a magnitude word follows.
Tashkent speech is heavily Russian-mixed: obed, produkt, zapravka, kommunalka, remont, podpiska, vozvrat, shtraf. Treat these as native Uzbek vocabulary, not foreign.

inverted_approximation.rule: RUSSIAN INVERTED NUMERAL ORDER = APPROXIMATION. Putting the numeral AFTER the magnitude word means 'about': 'тыщ двадцать' = about 20 000, 'тысяч сто' = about 100 000, 'лямов пять' = about 5 000 000, 'дней пять назад' = about five days ago. A parser that only handles <numeral><magnitude> reads 'тыщ' as an unattached magnitude and loses the amount entirely.

bank_sms_paste.rule: A large share of real input is PASTED VERBATIM from a bank push notification. Take the FIRST amount (the debit/credit) and ignore the trailing balance. The merchant often appears as an ALL-CAPS Latin string inside Cyrillic text. 'на сумму' is the most frequent real surface of сумма in payment language - it means 'in the amount of', it is NOT the currency сум.

self_correction.rule: The speaker restates an amount mid-utterance. Which figure wins depends on the marker: 'no wait' / 'yo'q' / 'emas' / 'нет' / 'ой' / 'то есть' -> the LATER figure is correct. 'not X' / 'X emas Y' with the correction FOLLOWING -> also the later figure. But English 'paid 300k not 400k' puts the correction second and negates it, so the FIRST figure wins. Confidence 0.6.

code_switch_rules.rule: switch points are CONTENT NOUNS and phrase boundaries, never digits
code_switch_rules.detail: Tashkent bilinguals code-switch on content nouns ('produkt', 'obed', 'zapravka', 'nasiya') and at clause boundaries. They keep numbers in ONE language, and overwhelmingly as digits or with the 'k' suffix. Fully spelled-out RUSSIAN numerals inside an Uzbek frame are real (especially in voice input) and a handful are kept. Fully spelled-out ENGLISH numerals inside an Uzbek frame do NOT occur and have been removed from the corpus.

code_switch_rules.rule: Uzbek suffixes attach to Uzbek stems
code_switch_rules.detail: 'produktlarga' is well formed; 'продуктыга' is not - you cannot hang -га off a Russian nominative plural -ы. The Cyrillic-stem-plus-Uzbek-suffix pattern IS real for singulars (магазинга, аптекага).

code_switch_rules.rule: izafet is required in noun-noun compounds
code_switch_rules.detail: 'poyezd bileti', 'bank komissiyasi', 'kvartira arendasi', 'uy remonti' - not 'poyezd bilet', 'bank komissiya', 'arenda kvartira', 'uydagi remont'.

code_switch_rules.rule: script mixing happens at WORD boundaries or as a single stray character
code_switch_rules.detail: 'Korzinkadan 90 минг' (word boundary) and 'невaрамга' (one stray Latin 'a') are real. Letter-by-letter interleaving such as 'prошlуyu пятницу' is not producible by any keyboard or dictation mechanism and has been removed. TRUE wrong-layout typing garbles a whole word through a consistent mapping: продукты -> 'ghjlerns', прошлую пятницу -> 'ghjike. gznybwe'.

The language of the verb, the copula and the case suffixes - not the language of the brand name. 'black bear coffee 45 ming' is uz; '45k taksiga' is uz; 'coffee 22 ming today' is uz and its script is LATIN.

yo_spelling_rule: Ё/Е: most phone keyboards do not surface ё, so the е-form is the MORE COMMON input. Every ё-entry in this file must have an е-counterpart, and both must hash to the same key: лепёшка/лепешка, приём/прием, съём/съем, бельё/белье, самолёт/самолет, путёвка/путевка, ребёнку/ребенку, счётчик/счетчик, кофеёк/кофеек, довёз/довез, тренажёрка/тренажерка, перерасчёт/перерасчет, нашёл/нашел, занёс/занес, днём/днем, четырёх/четырех, перевёл/перевел, ещё/еще.

matching_rules.rule: prefix matching is DANGEROUS for short keywords
matching_rules.detail: Keywords shorter than 4 characters must be matched as WHOLE TOKENS, not prefixes. Removed from this file for exactly this reason: bare 'un' (prefix-matched universitet, unda), bare 'pul' (collided head-on with gaz puli/utilities, yo'l puli/transport, uy puli/rent, cho'ntak puli/family, making the outcome list-order dependent), 'it ' and 'ит ' (a TRAILING SPACE made them unable to prefix-match anything at all - replaced by itim/itga/итим/итга).
'yandex plus' beats 'yandex'; 'uzum market' beats 'uzum'; 'gaz puli' beats 'gaz'; 'suv puli' beats 'suv'.

No surface may appear under two categories in this file, and no surface may be assigned to different categories in two lexicons. 'moyka/мойка' is transport everywhere; 'choyxona' is dining everywhere; 'massaj/массаж' is beauty everywhere; 'kvartplata' is utilities everywhere.
'25к' / '25 к' after a number is the thousand suffix. It was listed in BOTH magnitude_words and noise_words, so whichever list ran first silently won; it is now a magnitude token only.
'яндекс плюс' / 'яндекс лавка' / 'яндекс еда' beat the bare 'яндекс' -> taxi rule.
See hedge_words. чуть / около / примерно / где-то / вроде / ещё are polarity and estimate markers; the reject half of the gold depends on them surviving.

matching_rules.rule: 'gas' is ambiguous and the VERB/NOUN decides
matching_rules.detail: 'gas' + bill/utilities context -> utilities; 'gas' + station/tank/filled -> fuel. The noun alone never decides. See conventions.category_rules.gaz.

matching_rules.rule: 'outcome' is only an expense marker in the app-command frame
matching_rules.detail: 'add outcome 12k' is an expense; 'outcome was good yesterday' is the ordinary English noun and must be rejected.
The bare keyword could never fire correctly - the corpus resolves 'deposit interest' to investment and 'rent deposit returned' to refund. Only the multiword 'rent deposit' stays under rent.
'uzum market' beats 'uzum'; 'yandex plus' beats 'yandex'; 'gas bill' beats 'gas'.

matching_rules.rule: no surface may sit in two categories
matching_rules.detail: 'kafe' was in BOTH cafe_coffee and dining, and 'kvartplata' in BOTH rent and utilities, making any lookup order-dependent. Both are fixed: kafe -> cafe_coffee only, kvartplata -> utilities only.
'uzum market' beats 'uzum'; 'yandex plus' beats 'yandex'; 'gaz quydim' beats 'gaz'.

date_notes: See conventions.date_enum. Emits only the legal enum; there are no sentinel values.
